result:
I moved the "Team Created" success notification out of the component and into the mutation hook. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked.

- **`features/teams/api/create-team.ts`:** `useCreateTeam` now calls `useNotifications` and shows the success notification in its `onSuccess`. It does this after invalidating the teams query and before calling any caller-supplied `onSuccess`.
- **`features/teams/components/create-team.tsx`:** the component no longer imports or calls `useNotifications`. It just calls `useCreateTeam()`.

The same rule is also broken in older code outside this change. These components still call `useNotifications` themselves:
- the comments, users and discussions components
- `delete-comment.tsx`
- `delete-user.tsx`
- `update-profile.tsx`
- `create-discussion.tsx`
- `update-discussion.tsx`
- `delete-discussion.tsx`

I left those alone, since the feedback was about the new code.
